Name: New Island Crops
Author: AxelotlTheGreat
Description:
Description
This mod add 7 more island crops, 3 of which being trees. These can only be obtained from the island trader. These crops have a lot of custom produce and recipes, all of which can be purchased on the island.

Installation instructions
1. Click the download button
2. Unzip the file
3. Drag the folder to the mods folder

Main features
- Adds 4 new crops and 3 new fruit trees.
- Adds 2 new custom keg products and 1 preserves jar product.
- Adds 7 new recipes

Requirements
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher
- Stardew 1.6

Shout outs
Shout out to my brother @LionEagle15 for the sprites and my dad @dhfraser for helping me with this mod.
